item.title: 2026 Super Lawyers Awards Celebrate David Gammill, Founder of Gammill Law Accident & Injury Lawyers
item.description: The 2026 Super Lawyers awards have recognized the founder of Gammill Law as a recipient, recognizing him as a top-rated personal injury attorney in Torrance. The award highlights his dedication to helping injured parties throughout Los Angeles County and California.
